When running in multi-agent or dashboard mode (aiui.set_pages("all") or explicit page IDs), PraisonAIUI provides built-in pages and REST APIs for managing your agent fleet without restarting the server.

Plugin Page ID Capabilities & Endpoints Agents (builtin.agents) agents Create, edit, duplicate, delete and run agent definitions (GET/POST /api/agents/definitions, PUT/DELETE /api/agents/definitions/{id}, POST /api/agents/duplicate/{id}, POST /api/agents/run/{id}, GET /api/agents/models). Memory (builtin.memory) memory Browse, search and manage short-term, long-term and entity memory entries (GET/POST /api/memory, GET /api/memory/search, DELETE /api/memory/{id}). Install pip install "aiui[memory]" for vector backends. Skills (builtin.skills) skills Discover, register, configure and toggle reusable agent skills (GET/POST /api/skills, GET /api/skills/categories, POST /api/skills/{id}/toggle, PUT /api/skills/{id}/config).
Or register agents directly from Python with aiui.register_agent("researcher", agent) (see Python API) and manage knowledge bases in Knowledge & embeddings.
